This is where I'll be grouping all the things I'm working on, as that information is probably a bit more interesting then my off-of-topic personal life (though I assure you, while we're on that topic, that it is sufficiently interesting if you live in it).

A word or two about my classifications.  "Currently working on" means that I am actively editing, contributing to, or creating that item.  "Thinking about" means that I'm giving some (not necessarily serious) thought to moving that item up to "Currently working on."  For the items in "Love to help with" assume that I'd love to check them out and (maybe) add if they're off the ground and the ball is rolling.  "Pipe Dreams" are items that were in "Thinking about" but are a little intimidating.
